title: C482/428/2023 of SANJAY ALIAS SANJAY KUMAR RAVI Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND THROUGH SECRETARY HOME AFFAIRS, GOVERNMENT OF U.K. DEHRADUN

paras.text:

COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
C482 No.428 of 2023
Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Narendra Bali, Advocate for the
applicant.
Mr. Sachin Panwar, Brief Holder for the
State.
Mr. B.S. Bhandari, Advocate for the private
respondent.
The applicant is languishing in jail since
02.06.2022 for his alleged involvement in
commission of offences under Sections 363, 366,
376 (2)(n) of IPC and Sections 5 (1)/6, 5 (j)(ii)/6 of
POCSO Act, which was registered against the
present applicant at P.S. Sidcul, District Haridwar.
In relation to the aforesaid offences as
registered by way of an FIR No.0213 of 2022 dated
02.04.2022, the present applicant is a named
accused person therein. The criminal proceedings
have been put to motion by submission of the
charge sheet being Charge Sheet No.1 of 2022
dated 30.06.2022, and as a consequence thereto, the
criminal proceedings by way of Special Sessions
Trial No.95 of 2022, State vs. Sanjay Kumar, has
been put to motion before the Court of Special
Judge, POCSO/Additional District Judge,
Haridwar.
The present C482 application is supported

with the compounding application, wherein, the
parties to the proceedings, including the
complainant, who is the father of the victim
respondent no.3 is present in person, where, she had
made a statement, that the factum of marriage as
referred to in para 2 of the compounding
application and the fact of respondent no.2 having
given birth to a girl child is an admitted fact.
The parties to the proceeding seeks to
compound the offences. The fact of establishment
of a legally solemnized marriage is established by
placing on record the marriage registration
certificate dated 28.01.2022, wherein, as per the
registration made before the Registrar of Marriages
it was at Serial No.52 on page 349 to 378 of Vol.
281 dated 28.01.2022, the marriage dated
28.01.2022 has been registered.
This document too has been admitted by the
counsel for the parties, as well as the parties
themselves, who appear in person. It's not even
that even after solemnization of the said marriage, a
girl child has born out to the matrimony on
29.09.2022.
In that eventuality, these documents which
have not disputed by the complainant or the
respondent no.3 and particularly, when she has
made a statement that now she has a minor girl and
she is discharging her matrimonial obligations. The
applicant who is languishing in jail due to his
alleged involvement in commission of the offence,

which is subject matter of the C482 application, the
same deserves to be compounded in order to reunite
the family so that they may live in harmony.
Owing to the peculiar circumstances and
without creating any precedent as such, the C482
application would stand disposed of, and as a
consequence thereto, the proceedings of Special
Sessions Trial No.95 of 2022, State vs. Sanjay
Kumar, pending consideration before Special
Judge, POCSO/Addl. District Judge, Haridwar,
would hereby stand dropped and as an affect of
dropping of the proceeding as per provisions
contained under Section 320 of the Code of
Criminal Procedure, it would amount to be an
acquittal of an applicant, subject to the condition,
that he is not involved in any other case. As a
consequence of today's order, the applicant who is
languishing in jail is directed to be released
forthwith without any condition being imposed
upon him.
Subject to the aforesaid, C482 application
stands disposed of in terms of compounding
application.
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.) 17.03.2023
Ravi
I
